uk.question: Чим AI, ML і Deep Learning відрізняються?
uk.answer: AI — широка область систем для задач, які потребують інтелектуальної поведінки. ML вивчає patterns із data, а не лише explicit rules. Deep Learning — ML із багатошаровими neural networks. Rule-based agent теж може належати до AI; не кожна AI система є LLM.

en.question: How do AI, ML and Deep Learning differ?
en.answer: AI broadly concerns systems performing tasks requiring intelligent behaviour. ML learns patterns from data rather than relying only on explicit rules. Deep Learning is ML using multilayer neural networks. A rule-based agent may also be AI; not every AI system is an LLM.

uk.question: Що таке tokens і context window та як вони впливають на якість?
uk.answer: Token — одиниця tokenizer, не обов’язково слово. Context window обмежує обсяг доступного контексту; конкретний budget input/output залежить від моделі/API. Довгі histories можуть обрізатися або summaries втрачати деталі. Перевір position effects, multilingual text, tool outputs і явні limits; велике window не гарантує attention до всіх фактів.

en.question: What are tokens and context windows and how do they affect quality?
en.answer: A token is a tokenizer unit, not necessarily a word. The context window limits available context; input/output budgeting depends on the model/API. Long histories may be truncated or summaries lose detail. Test position effects, multilingual text, tool outputs and explicit limits; a large window does not guarantee attention to every fact.

uk.question: Чим completion model відрізняється від assistant і які model families знати?
uk.answer: Completion описує генерацію продовження; chat/instruction interfaces задають ролі й task-following. Assistant також може означати application з tools і memory, а не окрему архітектуру. Приклади families/providers: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Phi. Обирай за evals, hosting, license, privacy й cost, не за назвою.

en.question: How do completion models and assistants differ and which families matter?
en.answer: Completion describes continuation generation; chat/instruction interfaces introduce roles and task following. Assistant may mean an application with tools and memory rather than a distinct architecture. Examples include OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek and Phi. Select through evals, hosting, licence, privacy and cost rather than branding.

uk.question: Що таке AI guardrails?
uk.answer: Guardrails — конкретні обмеження й перевірки inputs, outputs і actions: schema, policy, permissions, budgets, moderation. Вони зменшують визначені ризики, але можуть мати false positives/negatives. Відмова unsafe action має контролюватися application, а не лише текстовою інструкцією моделі.

en.question: What are AI guardrails?
en.answer: Guardrails are concrete input, output and action constraints/checks: schema, policy, permissions, budgets and moderation. They reduce specified risks but can have false positives/negatives. The application should enforce denial of unsafe actions rather than relying only on model instructions.

uk.question: Чим encoder, decoder і Transformer відрізняються та що таке embeddings?
uk.answer: Transformer — architecture family з attention. Encoder часто формує contextual representations; autoregressive decoder генерує наступні tokens; encoder-decoder поєднує encoding та generation. Embedding — vector representation, де similarity може відображати learned relations. Це не гарантія однакового змісту чи factual correctness; оцінюй embedding на domain data.

en.question: How do encoders, decoders and Transformers differ and what are embeddings?
en.answer: Transformer is an architecture family using attention. Encoders often produce contextual representations; autoregressive decoders generate subsequent tokens; encoder-decoder models combine encoding and generation. An embedding is a vector representation whose similarity may reflect learned relations. It does not guarantee equivalent meaning or factual correctness; evaluate embeddings on domain data.

uk.question: Які типи ML і що потрібно для on-prem LLM?
uk.answer: Supervised ML навчається на labeled targets; unsupervised — шукає structure без таких labels; reinforcement learning оптимізує behaviour через rewards. On-prem потребує перевірки license, RAM/VRAM, quantization, serving, concurrency, security й updates. Вимірюй throughput, latency, memory та quality на своїх задачах.

en.question: What ML types exist and what is needed for on-prem LLM hosting?
en.answer: Supervised ML learns from labelled targets; unsupervised ML finds structure without those labels; reinforcement learning optimizes behaviour through rewards. On-prem hosting needs licence checks, RAM/VRAM, quantization, serving, concurrency, security and updates. Measure throughput, latency, memory and quality on your tasks.

uk.question: Чим guardrails відрізняються від загальної AI safety?
uk.answer: Guardrails — operational controls у конкретній системі. AI safety ширша: training choices, alignment, evaluations, misuse analysis, governance та incident response. Не прирівнюй content filter до безпеки всього продукту; перевір обходи, помилкові блокування й fail-open behaviour.

en.question: How do guardrails differ from broader AI safety?
en.answer: Guardrails are operational controls in a specific system. AI safety is broader: training choices, alignment, evaluations, misuse analysis, governance and incident response. Do not equate a content filter with overall product safety; test bypasses, false blocks and fail-open behaviour.

uk.question: Як перевіряти training і боротися з overfitting та underfitting?
uk.answer: Розділяй train/validation/test із захистом від leakage, дублювання й temporal overlap. Overfitting: модель добре працює на train, гірше узагальнює; underfitting: не відтворює потрібні закономірності. Допомагають appropriate capacity, regularization, data quality, early stopping і tuning. Перевір independent test set, slices і production shift.

en.question: How are training and overfitting or underfitting validated?
en.answer: Separate train/validation/test while preventing leakage, duplicates and temporal overlap. Overfitting means good training performance but poor generalization; underfitting means failure to learn necessary patterns. Appropriate capacity, regularization, data quality, early stopping and tuning can help. Check independent test sets, slices and production shifts.

uk.question: Що включає ефективний guardrail framework?
uk.answer: Risk inventory, policies, scoped permissions, input/context screening, output/schema checks, action authorization, human escalation, audit, telemetry й incident handling. Визнач thresholds і false-positive costs. Тестуй комбінацію model + tools + data, version policies і перевір drift; окремий moderator не замінює access control.

en.question: What belongs in an effective guardrail framework?
en.answer: Include a risk inventory, policies, scoped permissions, input/context screening, output/schema checks, action authorization, human escalation, audit, telemetry and incident handling. Define thresholds and false-positive costs. Test model + tools + data together, version policies and monitor drift; a moderator does not replace access control.
